0022600161.text: The Brooklyn Nets (0-5, on a five-game losing streak) visit the New York Knicks (2-4, having lost their last game) in a regular-season game that is the Nets' seventh of the season, with Brooklyn 0-3 at home and 0-2 on the road, sitting 5th in the Atlantic and 15th in the East. Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (leg bruise), Mikel Brown Jr. (rest) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain), while New York is without Jose Alvarado (ankle sprain). The Nets lost the 2025-26 season series 0-4, most recently a 93-92 loss in Brooklyn on March 20, 2026, and the two teams have not played each other yet this season.
